stories.headline: West Fraser plans two mill curtailments as housing demand stays weak
stories.body: West Fraser will indefinitely curtail its Huguley oriented strand board mill in Lanett, Alabama, and its lumber mill in Leola, Arkansas. The October 28 announcement expects fourth-quarter wind-downs.

stories.headline: Domtar describes changes from climate-risk assessment to field practice
stories.body: Domtar’s October 28 account describes designated skid trails, drone seeding and changes to regeneration in its Canadian forests. The company says a 2022 climate-risk assessment helped set priorities.
stories.region: CANADA — FOREST MANAGEMENT / OCTOBER 28 COMPANY REPORT

stories.headline: Middle Enoree timber sale offers thinning and regeneration work
stories.body: South Carolina’s Department of Natural Resources is seeking per-ton bids for its Middle Enoree 2026 timber sale in Sumter National Forest. Bids open November 18 at 11 a.m.; they must arrive before opening.
stories.region: SOUTH — SOUTH CAROLINA / BIDS DUE NOVEMBER 18

stories.headline: Maine retains ash-borer quarantine after opposition to repeal
stories.body: Maine will keep its emerald ash borer quarantine after abandoning a proposed repeal, Maine Public reported October 28. State Horticulturist Gary Fish said more than 80 comments arrived, nearly all urging retention.

featuredResource.title: Continuous Improvement in Logging
featuredResource.description: This book applies the Theory of Constraints to finding and managing bottlenecks in logging operations. It combines a five-step improvement process, throughput accounting and productivity references to help operators focus changes where they affect overall output.
